nameOrigin: type of rabbit whose ears droop down
slang for rabbit, a small mammal with long ears

pokedexEntries.di: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

pokedexEntries.prl: It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

pokedexEntries.pt: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.

pokedexEntries.bw: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

pokedexEntries.x: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

pokedexEntries.or: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

pokedexEntries.y: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

pokedexEntries.as: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

pokedexEntries.us: Lopunny regrows its coat twice a year. Mufflers and hats made from its fur are really warm.

pokedexEntries.um: It’s notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

pokedexEntries.sw: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

pokedexEntries.sh: Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny’s coat will be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating air in preparation for colder weather.

pokedexEntries.bd: An extremely cautious Pokémon that cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

pokedexEntries.shp: It likes to keep itself clean and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

pokedexEntries.la: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

pokedexEntries.za: This Pokémon's ears are apparently very delicate. They must be handled gently and with care, or else Lopunny will kick you with its graceful legs.
